svg.text: 20S10P pack wiring and Daly 200 A sense harness
200 cells · each row of 10 is one parallel group · half 2 mirrored so both 37.0 V terminals meet at the bottom
Every row of 10 cells is one parallel group. Voltage
climbs 3.7 V per row, not across the columns.
Adjacent rows are flipped, so one zigzag ties the
+ faces of a row to the − faces of the next.
Visible face: S1–S2, S3–S4, S5–S6, S7–S8, S9–S10.
Hidden face: S2–S3, S4–S5, S6–S7, S8–S9.
Half 2 runs S20 at the top down to S11 at the bottom,
so its 37.0 V end sits beside half 1's.
Nickel is short lapped pieces welded cell to cell.
21 conductors: B− plus B1 through B20.
B− lands on the S1 underside, B20 on the S20
underside. Every other tap sits on a nickel
zigzag, alternating visible and hidden face.
B10 is one node shared by both halves — land a
single wire on it, not two.
Land B− first, then B1 upward in order. Check
each pin against the printed voltage before
